title: AAPS-CI build fails with Stack Overflow
symptom: AAPS-CI builds fail with a StackOverflow Error, happening intermittently (yesterday 1x, today 2x). The failure location differs, and it affects both release and debug builds.
cause: The thread suggests that the Gradle build is running out of stack resources, possibly due to insufficient JVM stack size settings.
fix: Adjust Gradle JVM arguments to increase stack size and memory, e.g., setting org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xss1024m -Xms64m or using -Xmx8g -XX:+UseParallelGC, and setting kotlin.daemon.jvm.options=-Xmx2g and kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process. A PR (#4104) was created to adjust the CI build based on these suggestions.
evidence_quote: I changed my values to: org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx8g -XX:+UseParallelGC # Kotlin compiler/daemon heap kotlin.daemon.jvm.options=-Xmx2g kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process Haven't had problem since...
